title: Lz Hub
features:
Lz Hub - Forge Script Features
Main Tab
Auto Mine
[+] Automatically mines selected rocks
[+] Prioritize shiny rocks option
[+] Adjustable tween speed (16-80)
[+] Multi-rock selection support
[+] Detects when someone else is mining
Auto Kill
[+] Automatically hunts down enemies
[+] Selects specific enemy types
[+] Smooth tweening to targets
[+] Customizable movement speed
[+] Works on both zombie and skeleton islands
Misc
[+] One-click redeem all active codes
Auto Forge Tab
[+] Automatically completes hammer minigame
[+] Auto-completes melt minigame
[+] Auto-completes pour minigame
[+] Instant forge mode (skips melt/pour)
Items Tab
Auto Sell
[+] Select which ores to sell
[+] Customizable cooldown timer (1-1800 seconds)
[+] Multi-item selection
[+] Auto-talks to Greedy Cey
Auto Use Potions
[+] Automatically uses selected potions
[+] Supports Luck, Miner, Damage, Health, and Speed potions
[+] Keeps buffs active at all times
Quests Tab
[+] One-click quest refresh
[+] Auto-complete any quest
[+] Automatically farms kill quests
[+] Automatically farms mining quests
[+] Progress tracking
[+] Notifies when quest is complete
Teleports Tab
[+] 30+ teleport locations
[+] Adjustable teleport speed
[+] NPCs, shops, and key locations
Misc Tab
Player Mods
[+] Hide username and stats
[+] Flight mode with WASD controls
[+] Adjustable flight speed (20-120)
Utility
[+] Anti-AFK system
